summary: Implemented automatic release of a delivered worker's registered Herdr tabs without deleting branch, worktree, result, logs, or materials. After a valid delivered result is durably recorded, the supervisor (and a repeated stop for old records) confirms each registered session is exited, the worktree status is confirmable and clean, and each registered tab still holds only that worker's panes and agents; it then exits the TUI and closes only registered tabs. Strict agent queries (only agent_not_found proves exit), post-exit re-verification, per-tab re-verification before each close, per-worker stop locking, live-supervisor ownership, and shape-validated occupancy listings all retain the tab with a recorded reason reachable from status. Added deterministic regression coverage for both runtimes and every retain/race path, and updated the current operations docs. Review follow-ups on unknown-agent evidence, post-exit rechecks, stop/supervisor locking, malformed occupancy (including empty IDs and conflicting tabs), and the multi-tab per-close race are all addressed.

acceptance.criterion: Pi/OpenCode valid delivered: durably record delivery, confirm business stopped, safely exit TUI and close the registered tab; idle/done with no result or an invalid result must not auto-close
acceptance.evidence: The supervisor saves state (durable delivery) before calling release_delivered_tabs, then saves the release decision. test_delivered_worker_releases_its_tab[pi/opencode] observes release.state=closed, the tab gone from the fake pane registry, and lifecycle delivered; test_no_valid_result_retains_the_tab[pi/opencode x missing-result/needs-decision] observes release.state=retained, lifecycle unchanged, and zero tab-close calls.

acceptance.criterion: Release does not depend on ack, integration, or worktree cleanup, and does not change delivered/ack/integration semantics
acceptance.evidence: test_delivered_worker_releases_its_tab closes the tab before any ack, merge, or cleanup while asserting the delivery item, branch, worktree, and result remain; cleanup afterwards still succeeds. release_delivered_tabs never mutates state['result'], state['lifecycle'], or items.

acceptance.criterion: Auto-close only affects the worker's registered terminals; foreign occupants or extra unregistered panes are not closed, and running old/new handoff sessions are not wrongly closed
acceptance.evidence: release_delivered_tabs requires every registered agent to be explicitly agent_not_found (or settled for the pre-exit check) and checks pane-to-tab ownership. test_foreign_pane_retains_the_tab (unregistered-pane + foreign-agent), test_foreign_pane_in_second_tab_blocks_its_close, and test_foreign_pane_added_during_exit_retains_the_tab all observe retained tabs with no close.

acceptance.criterion: Conservative retain conditions (uncommitted/untracked content, unconfirmable git status, still writing, exit failure) with a visible reason; close failure keeps the delivered result and does not become a business failure or retry indefinitely
acceptance.evidence: test_dirty_worktree_retains_the_delivered_tab records reason uncommitted-content; test_uncommitted_content_added_during_exit_retains_the_tab records an exit-time write as post-exit uncommitted-content; test_malformed_occupancy_data_retains_the_tab records tab-occupancy-unverified for missing/empty/bad entries; test_tab_close_failure_keeps_delivery_and_releases_on_retry records tab-close-failed with lifecycle delivered, zero exception items, worktree intact, and a later stop succeeding; worktree_status_facts treats a missing worktree or failed git status as unconfirmed.

acceptance.criterion: Branch, worktree, result, logs, materials, and uncommitted files are retained; disk cleanup still needs an explicit cleanup decision
acceptance.evidence: test_delivered_worker_releases_its_tab asserts worktree, result file, and branch survive release, then cleanup --disposition removes the worktree idempotently; no release path removes or archives anything, and cleanup_state_facts still requires a recorded decision.

acceptance.criterion: Stop failure or abnormal tickets retain the terminal; delivered records whose supervisor already exited reuse the same close path via another stop, without a second close protocol
acceptance.evidence: test_no_valid_result_retains_the_tab stops a failure scene and keeps the tab; test_stop_releases_a_delivered_record_without_a_release deletes the release record, reopens the tab, and shows stop closing it through release_delivered_tabs; test_dirty_worktree_retains_the_delivered_tab retries through stop after committing the artifact.

acceptance.criterion: Persistently record the terminal close/retain reason queryable from status; respect the single writer and supervisor/stop coordination; repeated stop and already-closed tabs are idempotent; normal close creates no fake agent-exited/supervisor-missing
acceptance.evidence: worker_facts and the stop payload expose state['release']; test_repeated_stop_and_already_closed_tab_are_idempotent observes no additional tab-close call and business_stopped true; release never appends items or changes lifecycle, so status keeps lifecycle delivered and no agent-exited item appears.

acceptance.criterion: Deterministic verification covers dual-runtime successful auto-close, no premature close when the result arrives while still working, no-valid-result and failure retention, dirty worktree retention, close failure/foreign occupancy retention, repeated stop, and subsequent cleanup
acceptance.evidence: Focused run: 38 passed, 63 deselected (command in verification). It includes test_early_result_does_not_close_a_working_session (no release while working, closed after settlement), both runtimes, and all retain paths listed above.

acceptance.criterion: Implement in the isolated worktree with the minimal necessary patch, run focused and full tests, update current operations docs, and keep historical smoke records as they were; the coordinator owns the real dual-runtime smoke and legacy tab handling
acceptance.evidence: Commit 6d0a7e05364375421ac6fddedffff88e76693e54 on hpm/w08-tab-release changes only bin/plan_manager.py, tests/fakes/bin/herdr, tests/test_plan_manager.py, and docs/plan-management/{operations,SKILL}.md; python3 -m py_compile exit 0; focused run 38 passed; python3 -m pytest tests/ -q exit 0 with 144 passed; .scratch historical evidence is untouched and the worktree is clean.

acceptance.criterion: Review follow-up 1: unknown agent queries are not exit evidence; only an explicit agent_not_found proves exit, errors are retained with a recorded reason, and a registered agent still listed as working blocks the close
acceptance.evidence: Herdr.agent_fact returns known=False with the error for any non-agent_not_found failure, and wait_agent_exited only accepts explicit agent_not_found. test_unknown_agent_query_is_not_exit_evidence records session-state-unknown with the TUI file still present; test_registered_agent_listed_as_working_blocks_release records session-not-settled from the agent listing even though agent get reported not_found.

acceptance.criterion: Review follow-up 2: ownership and git status are re-verified after the exit waits, so changes during exit block the close
acceptance.evidence: release_delivered_tabs re-runs registered_agent_facts, worktree_status_facts, and tab_occupancy_facts after exiting. test_foreign_pane_added_during_exit_retains_the_tab and test_uncommitted_content_added_during_exit_retains_the_tab both observe phase=post-exit retention.

acceptance.criterion: Review follow-up 3: stop never takes over from a live supervisor, and concurrent stops without a supervisor serialize per worker
acceptance.evidence: cmd_stop returns stop-incomplete whenever the recorded supervisor PID is still alive, regardless of lifecycle state, and all mutating stop paths take a per-worker stop.lock. test_stop_does_not_take_over_from_a_live_supervisor observes exit 3, business_stopped false, and no new tab close; test_concurrent_stops_without_a_supervisor_serialize observes exactly one close and release attempts=1.

acceptance.criterion: Review follow-up 4: pane_list/agent_list validate shape and identity fields, reject empty IDs, and malformed or non-object results become ManagerError so the release records an unconfirmed state and retains
acceptance.evidence: Both listings validate result is an object, the list field, and non-empty string pane_id/tab_id per entry. test_malformed_occupancy_data_retains_the_tab covers missing-tab, element-not-object, result-not-object, empty-pane-id, and empty-tab-id; test_malformed_agent_list_retains_the_tab covers the agent listing; test_registered_pane_under_conflicting_tab_retains_the_tab records pane-tab-conflict when a registered pane is reported under another tab.

acceptance.criterion: Review follow-up 5: occupancy and conditions are re-verified before each tab close, not once for the whole set, with a deterministic multi-tab injection; the missing conditional-close API is documented as a capability boundary
acceptance.evidence: release_delivered_tabs runs tab_conditions immediately before every close. test_foreign_pane_in_second_tab_blocks_its_close closes tab A, injects a foreign pane into tab B during that close, and observes tab B retained with phase=pre-close while tab A is closed; docs/plan-management/operations.md documents that Herdr has no atomic conditional close and that the residual race is narrowed but not eliminated.
